CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openbot_internal.thread_history_terminal_payload(p_type text, p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'openbot_internal'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_type IN('completed','cancelled') THEN
  RETURN p_payload IS NOT DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('status',p_type);
 ELSIF p_type IN('failed','reconciliation_required') THEN
  RETURN COALESCE(p_payload->>'errorCode'=ANY(ARRAY[
   'agent_runtime_unavailable','runtime_lease_expired','dispatch_payload_corrupt','dispatch_dead_letter',
   'provider_authentication','provider_rate_limited','provider_unavailable','provider_commit_unknown',
   'provider_invalid_response','agent_stream_stalled','provider_generation_failed','provider_token_budget_exceeded',
   'run_token_budget_exceeded','run_cost_budget_unpriced','run_cost_budget_currency_mismatch','run_cost_budget_exceeded',
   'tool_step_limit','tool_loop_unavailable','tool_denied','run_deadline_exceeded','journal_commit_unknown']::text[]),false)
   AND p_payload IS NOT DISTINCT FROM
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('status',p_type,'errorCode',p_payload->>'errorCode');
 END IF;
 RETURN false;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openbot_internal.prevent_thread_history_writer_truncate()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'openbot_internal'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'TRUNCATE' OR TG_LEVEL<>'STATEMENT' OR
    (TG_TABLE_SCHEMA='public' AND TG_TABLE_NAME NOT IN('messages','runs','run_events','channels')) OR
    (TG_TABLE_SCHEMA='openbot_internal' AND TG_TABLE_NAME<>'channel_history_sources') OR
    TG_TABLE_SCHEMA NOT IN('public','openbot_internal') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='55000',MESSAGE='thread_history_writer_binding_invalid';
 END IF;
 RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='55000',MESSAGE='thread_history_writer_truncate_refused';
END;
$function$
